import sys

def main():
    n = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
    ones = [0] * 17
    for i in range(1, 17):
        ones[i] = 10 * ones[i-1] + 1
    ans = dfs(ones, n, 16)
    print(ans)

def dfs(ones, n, idx):
    quot = n // ones[idx]
    rem = n % ones[idx]
    used = quot * idx
    if rem == 0:
        return used
    else:
        return used + min(dfs(ones, rem, idx-1),
                          idx + dfs(ones, ones[idx] - rem, idx-1))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
